raw_response: {"findings":[{"path":"tornado/ioloop.py","line":251,"end_line":254,"severity":"high","category":"bug","title":"initialize 的 make_current=True 分支条件取反，导致总是抛异常或从不抛异常","explanation":"initialize 中 make_current 为真时，本意是“若已存在 current IOLoop 则报错，否则把自己设为 current”。但代码写的是 `if IOLoop.current(instance=False) is None: raise RuntimeError(...)`，条件与语义相反：当当前线程没有 current IOLoop（正常可设置的情况）时反而抛 RuntimeError；当已经存在 current IOLoop 时却静默覆盖它。这与 make_current=None 分支（current 为 None 时才 make_current）的逻辑也不一致。","trigger":"IOLoop(make_current=True) 在尚无 current IOLoop 的线程中构造：current(instance=False) 返回 None，进入 raise 分支，抛出 RuntimeError(\"current IOLoop already exists\")，尽管实际上并不存在冲突。","evidence":"248-250 行：`if make_current is None: if IOLoop.current(instance=False) is None: self.make_current()`；251-254 行：`elif make_current: if IOLoop.current(instance=False) is None: raise RuntimeError(\"current IOLoop already exists\"); self.make_current()`。两分支对同一条件 `is None` 的处理相反，且异常消息与触发条件矛盾。","suggestion":"将条件改为 `if IOLoop.current(instance=False) is not None: raise RuntimeError(\"current IOLoop already exists\")`，再调用 self.make_current()。"}]}
